policy.order: per case: warm-up runs (A then B, excluded from comparison), then 3 A-B-B-A block(s), then optional cold-resume checks
policy.process: every sample is a new process of the arm's binary
policy.reference: each case's first completed sample; every later sample's run tree is compared with it
policy.work_path: each case writes to its fixed output directory; the driver moves the run under runs/ after each sample

common.rule:
The comparison rule (#594 item 3): fewer than two complete A-B-B-A
blocks, an effect no larger than the observed run-to-run spread (the
larger arm's max minus min over its median), or blocks that disagree in
direction is inconclusive; otherwise the candidate/baseline median ratio
is an improvement or a regression.

note: Floats are rounded to six significant digits; outputs_sha256 pins the raw files.
